_说明: viewer3d.html?model=enforcement_low 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。只画外观：加固、破旧的执法局下层分局（主楼、封板西翼、对外窗口、双道闸口、车场）；周边棚户与中层底面（bg_*）只在成图里。位置与形制为仓库推断。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 分局主楼：四层加固混凝土，窄条窗与防爆卷闸，西翼已封板停用；执法局下层分局名义上六个，实际运转的只有三个。
desc.en: Branch main block: four-storey reinforced concrete with slit windows and blast shutters; the west wing is boarded up and disused. The Bureau has six lower branches on paper, only three actually operating.

desc.zh: 对外窗口：钢板墙段上的厚玻璃递物窗与托盘，上有钢雨棚。
desc.en: Public counter: thick glazed hatch with a pass-through tray in a steel-plated wall, under a steel canopy.

desc.zh: 车辆闸口：两道推拉钢门、中间待检区、道闸与岗亭。
desc.en: Vehicle sally port: two sliding steel gates with a holding bay between them, a barrier arm and a guard booth.

desc.zh: 车场：锈蚀铁丝网围栏、车棚与充电桩。
desc.en: Motor pool: rusted chain-link fence, carport and charging posts.

desc.zh: 深色无标识厢式车与悬浮摩托。
desc.en: Dark unmarked vans and hover bikes.

desc.zh: 防撞柱、水马迷宫、Hesco 防爆墙与监控摄像头。
desc.en: Anti-ram bollards, a jersey-barrier maze, a Hesco blast wall and cameras.

desc.zh: 带钢笼的墙面与灯杆投光灯、街灯（有一盏已坏）。
desc.en: Caged wall and mast floodlights and street lamps, one of them broken.

desc.zh: 补过的沥青、积水与油渍。
desc.en: Patched asphalt, puddles and oil stains.
